decisions.title: Use Dafny for core logic
decisions.context: Core business logic (budget, registry, payment, failure) must be verified for correctness.
decisions.decision: Implement core logic in Dafny with Z3-verified contracts.
decisions.consequences: Higher upfront cost but reduced runtime errors.

decisions.title: ASP.NET Core for API layer
decisions.context: Need a robust web framework for REST endpoints.
decisions.decision: Use ASP.NET Core for the API shell, delegating to Dafny modules.

openRisks.mitigation: Implement strict configuration validation and separate test environments.
openRisks.description: Failure injection might accidentally affect production traffic if misconfigured.

openRisks.mitigation: Use proven registry patterns and incremental verification.
openRisks.description: Dafny verification may increase development time for complex state machines.

components.name: Contracts
components.internals: Contains Dafny datatypes for budget, service registry entries, payment requests/results, failure injection configs, and common error types. No dependencies.

testCases.name: Budget datatype validation
testCases.description: Verify Budget datatype fields are accessible and correctly typed.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Budget has amount (int) and currency (string) fields.

components.responsibility: Defines shared types, interfaces, and constants for the marketplace platform.

components.name: BudgetEnforcer
components.internals: Implements budget enforcement logic: checks if a transaction exceeds the budget, reserves funds, releases funds on cancellation, and tracks budget status. Uses state-machine pattern for budget lifecycle.

testCases.name: Budget check within limit
testCases.description: Verify CheckBudget returns true when amount is less than or equal to remaining budget.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CheckBudget returns true for amount within budget.

components.responsibility: Enforces budget limits for marketplace transactions.

components.name: ServiceRegistry
components.internals: Implements service registration, lookup, and health monitoring. Uses repository pattern for storing service entities.

testCases.name: Register service
testCases.description: Verify RegisterService adds a service to the registry.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Service is added and can be retrieved by ID.

components.responsibility: Maintains a registry of available services and their health status.

components.name: PaymentProcessor
components.internals: Implements payment simulation: processes payments, refunds, and tracks payment status. Uses state-machine pattern for payment lifecycle.

testCases.name: Process payment
testCases.description: Verify ProcessPayment returns success for a valid payment request.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Payment is processed and status is completed.

components.responsibility: Simulates payment processing for marketplace transactions.

components.name: FailureInjector
components.internals: Implements failure injection: configures failures (e.g., latency, errors) for services. Uses scheduler pattern to manage failure schedules.

testCases.name: Inject failure
testCases.description: Verify InjectFailure adds a failure configuration.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Failure is active and can be retrieved.

components.responsibility: Injects failures into the system for resilience testing.

components.name: MarketplaceApi
components.internals: ASP.NET Core Web API that orchestrates calls to BudgetEnforcer, ServiceRegistry, PaymentProcessor, and FailureInjector. Handles HTTP I/O and delegates to Dafny logic.
components.responsibility: Exposes REST endpoints for the marketplace platform.

dataStores.name: PaymentStore
dataStores.schema: Payment(Id, RequestId, Amount, Currency, Status, Timestamp)

systemContext: A multi-repo .NET marketplace platform that enforces budgets, maintains a service registry, simulates payment processing, and supports failure injection for resilience testing.

qualityAttributes.target: System remains available during injected failures
qualityAttributes.rationale: Failure injection is used to test and improve resilience.

qualityAttributes.target: Budget enforcement is correct within 0.01% error
qualityAttributes.rationale: Financial transactions require precise budget tracking.

qualityAttributes.target: API response time under 200ms for 95% of requests
qualityAttributes.rationale: Marketplace needs fast response times for user experience.

deploymentTopology: Multiple .NET services deployed as containers in a Kubernetes cluster, with a shared database per service.
